pages.text: What a wizard casts in combat is decided by two things: which $(bold)magic scrolls sit in the strategy bar$(), and the $(bold)overall preset$() you pick.$(br2)How to open: $(bold)aim your crosshair at a wizard and right-click → info screen → the "Strategy" button$(); the Strategy button in the Mage Hut's Promotion & Commands card opens the same screen.

A wizard's combat spells come entirely from the scrolls loaded into the 12 strategy slots — wizards do not know a whole spellbook by default. To let a wizard cast something, load its scroll into the bar:$(br2)$(li)Wandscape's own $(bold)magic scrolls$() are synthesized from elements at the $(l:wandscape:magic_station_guide)Magic Workshop$(/l), each bound to one spell (e.g. Beam, Meteor).$(li)The 3 starting wizards that come with a new colony have Beam + Meteor loaded by default; $(bold)wizards hired from the tavern start with no combat magic$() — craft them scrolls first if you want them to fight.$(li)With Iron's Spells or Goety installed, their scrolls / focuses can also go into the bar — see below.
pages.title: A wizard's spells come from scrolls

pages.text: $(bold)Scroll slots (middle)$(): 12 slots arranged in four category rows — $(bold)Single-target / AoE / Defense / Support$(), three per row. Drag a scroll from your inventory into a slot to equip it (take it out to get the scroll back; $(bold)Shift$() moves it quickly):$(br2)$(li)The row you drop a scroll into decides which category it counts as for the casting order; spells are de-duplicated and each row holds at most 3.$(li)Slot order within a row (top → bottom) = casting priority inside that category; higher up casts first.$(br2)$(bold)Overall preset (4 buttons at the top)$(): decides the priority between the four categories:$(br2)$(bold)Preset  Casting order (high → low)$()$(li)$(bold)Balanced$() — AoE → Single-target → Support → Defense$(li)$(bold)Offensive$() — Single-target → AoE → Defense → Support$(li)$(bold)Support$() — Support (heal first) → Defense → AoE → Single-target$(li)$(bold)Defensive$() — Defense → Support → AoE → Single-target$(br2)The "$(bold)Special$()" column on the right is read-only: inherent spells like Teleport and Heal are listed there — used by default by every wizard and cannot be changed; they only fire in specific situations (self-heal when in danger, teleport on pathing failure).
pages.title: Two settings: load scrolls + pick a preset

pages.text: $(li)When auto-casting, the wizard scans from high to low by "preset category order → in-row slot order" and picks the $(bold)first castable$() one: valid target, cooldown passed, mana sufficient.$(li)$(bold)Changes save instantly$() — no confirmation; each wizard's slots are configured individually.$(li)Altar spells (like Revive) are neither auto-cast nor equippable — see the $(l:wandscape:altar_guide)Altar$(/l).$(li)Magic that is not loaded into the strategy bar is never cast.
pages.title: Mechanics

pages.text: $(bold)Iron's Spells scrolls$() can only be equipped on a wizard wearing a $(bold)spell book$() in their curio slot. The number of scrolls you can load = the $(bold)spell book's capacity$() (the more spells a book can hold, the higher its tier). Without a book, scrolls can't be placed, and any already placed ones are $(bold)disabled but kept$() — they resume once a book is equipped.$(br2)$(bold)Goety focuses$() require the wizard to hold a $(bold)Goety wand in their main hand$() (the staff slot), and only $(bold)one focus$() fits in the whole bar at a time. Without a wand, focuses can't be placed, and any placed ones are disabled until a wand is equipped.$(br2)Give the wizard its spell book through the $(l:wandscape:npc_guide)Wizard Panel$(/l)'s trinket entry and its Goety wand through the wand slot. Native Wandscape scrolls are not affected by these gates.$(br2)$(italic)$(#6b5a45)When third-party magic is loaded, the strategy screen shows a status line at the bottom (e.g. "Iron 2/5", "Focus 1/1"); missing gear turns it into a warning ("No spell book: Iron off", "No wand: focus off"). Holding a gated scroll over a slot shows the blocking reason in red.$()$(br2)$(l:wandscape:npc_guide)Wizard NPC Guide$(/l)$(br2)$(l:wandscape:altar_guide)Altar (Ritual Spells like Revive)$(/l)$(br2)$(l:wandscape:index_guide)Back to the Guide Index$(/l)
pages.title: Third-party spells need the right gear
